scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind your digital footprint.
Respect: means communicating without insults. Permission: is needed before sharing another person's photo.
Digital footprint: is information left by online activity. Report: tells a trusted adult about online harm. Pause: means thinking before posting.
Use an imaginary example or a teacher-approved offline screenshot. Discuss when to use respect and permission. Never enter a real password or share private details in this activity.
